answer: To resist sybil attacks, an agent economy can bond each identity to a refundable stake locked against its signing key before it may earn. Spinning up a thousand fake agents then costs a thousand bonds, so an attacker never reaches the zenith of influence cheaply. A shared reputation atlas maps every key to its slashing history, and honest work accrues like a polished opal: slowly, verifiably, and impossible to counterfeit in bulk.
